title: A Logarithmic Fluctuation Hierarchy for Sequential Interacting Diffusions
summary: We study Gaussian fluctuations for a lower-triangular system of interacting diffusions in which particle $i$ interacts only with its predecessors. Although the empirical measure of this system converges to the same McKean--Vlasov limit as in the corresponding exchangeable mean-field system, the sequential structure remains visible at the $N^{-1/2}$ fluctuation scale.
